findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 揭露英國集體訴訟（索賠逾 £10 億英鎊）及美國 EMV 責任轉移集體訴訟（原告主張單一損害逾 $10 億）。
findings.excerpt: The plaintiffs submitted expert reports that allege aggregate single damages in excess of $1 billion against the four Network Defendants.
